sources.what: Main residential plans page; plan grid shows placeholders and 'We are currently updating our Geneco plans'. Banner: Get It Fixed 24 29.00¢/kWh vs SP's 31.16¢/kWh, up to $255 rebates, limited time.
Campaign page: 'LIMITED TIME SPECIAL: $200 bill rebates + 29.00¢/kWh for SP Customers only'. Other plan cards are images (unreadable).
Offers index: GIF24 $200/$100, GIF12 $15, 7to7 $65 (expired), card-partner rebates.
GENECO200 T&Cs: 1 Sep–16 Oct 2026, SP customers new to Geneco, GIF24 only, first 2,750.
GENECO100 T&Cs: 1–30 Sep 2026 (web page says till 16 Oct — conflict).
GENECO15 T&Cs: 1 Sep–31 Oct 2026, GIF12 only, first 250.
Plan cards read in a real browser (rendered page): GIF12 30.50, GIF24 29.00, Give Us A Try 31.00, 7 To 7 27.90/32.50, all incl. GST

plans.name: Get It Fixed 24

promo.title: Bill rebate for new sign-ups (online only)
promo.value: S$200 for current SP Group customers (GENECO200); S$100 for others (GENECO100)

plans.notes: 29.00¢ is open to all new customers, limited to the first 1,000 sign-ups (banner also says FIRST 1000 ONLY). SP customers get S$200 rebate (GENECO200), others S$100 (GENECO100).
plans.evidence: Get It Fixed 24 24 months 29.00 ¢/kWh (inc. GST) Exclusive rate for the first 1000 sign-ups. For SP Customers: Use promo code GENECO200 for $200 bill rebate. For all other customers: Use promo code GENECO100 for $100 bill rebate.

plans.name: Get It Fixed 12
plans.evidence: Get It Fixed 12 12 months 30.50 ¢/kWh (inc. GST) Use promo code GENECO15 ($15 bill rebate, limited sign-ups). T&Cs apply.

plans.name: Give Us A Try
plans.evidence: Give Us A Try 6 months 31.00 ¢/kWh (inc. GST) Promotion and referral codes are not applicable.

plans.name: Get It 7 To 7
plans.evidence: Get It 7 To 7 24 months 7pm - 7am 27.90 ¢/kWh (inc. GST) 7am - 7pm 32.50 ¢/kWh (inc. GST) Promotion and referral codes are not applicable.

issues: Plan cards only render in a real browser; read that way on 12 Oct. GENECO100 dates conflict (web: to 16 Oct; T&C: to 30 Sep).
